text: The implementation of AI in medicine is good. It helps doctors a lot. But some people are afraid. I think AI is the future of health and it will save many lives in the next ten years.

While the proliferation of generative AI facilitates rapid content production, it simultaneously threatens the ontological security of academic integrity. Consequently, the pedagogical paradigm must shift from product-oriented assessment to process-oriented evaluation to mitigate systemic plagiarism.

The ozone layer is disappearing because of chemicals. However, the government does not care. Also, the weather is getting hot. In conclusion, we must stop pollution now or the world will end soon. This is a very bad situation for everyone.
AI can be use for teach English. It is very helpful for student. The teacher can use AI to make test. But some students use it for cheat. This is why we need new rules in school for use AI.

Moreover, the socio-economic disparities are increasing. Thus, the digital divide is a problem. In addition, the internet is fast. Therefore, education is important. Finally, we can say that technology is a double-edged sword.
